summary_line: Quay Street's four lamp posts (x 8, 18, 28, 38, alternate sides) are precast concrete columns, the main build since the review of 9 October: a square shaft 220 at the foot tapering to 125 at 4.62 m with 15 mm chamfered arrises, a door recess 120 x 330 with a blank steel plate at z 450 to 780, a 90 x 45 reference plate 'LC n', and a black cast cap carrying a plain bent-arm bracket (a 48 stem, ONE 90 degree bend of radius 130, a straight LEVEL arm reaching 430 from the axis) into the rear boss of a boat-shaped aluminium canopy (550 x 300 x 200, its top at 5000, centred 705 out, the lantern in line with the arm) over a yellowed clear bowl with a 54 x 310 sodium lamp and a U-shaped arc tube inside it; the painted-steel stepped column of the 2019 photographs (a 124 sleeve 978 high, a 60 mm cone, a 68-to-60 shaft, a 250 socket sleeve for the same bracket) is kept in full as the alternative; the lit lantern is orange (255, 137, 0), the scene's (255, 219, 0) being the colour of 585 nm, not 589; no photograph of a concrete column with a sodium lantern taken before 2000 was found (three of 1989 show steel columns with near-level arms and the lantern in line; the concrete ones are of 2008 to 2010, original lanterns by their photographers' word), so every concrete length is Judgement within the photographs' span.

decision_type.main: C: a precast concrete column (a square shaft 220 at the foot tapering to 125 at 4620, arrises chamfered 15, planted), a cast-steel cap and a plain bent-arm steel bracket (a 48 stem, ONE 90 degree bend of radius 130, a straight LEVEL arm 300 long reaching 430 from the axis) entering the rear boss of a boat-shaped aluminium canopy (550 x 300 x 200, its top at 5000, its centre 705 out) over a deep yellowed clear bowl with a 54 x 310 sodium lamp and a U-shaped arc tube inside it, the lamp's long axis along the arm; 4 columns at x 8, 18, 28, 38, alternate sides
alternatives: A: painted-steel stepped column (124 sleeve, cone, 68-to-60 shaft, a 250 socket) with the same bracket geometry and lantern (written in full; built only if ruled in)
P: post-top dish on the same lower column (what BGE shows; not placed)
W1: a wall bracket for the same lantern (optional; not placed)

canopy.section: at each y the dome is a half ellipse: z = dome_base_z + (top_z(y) - dome_base_z) x sqrt(1 - (x / w(y))^2), w(y) from plan_half_width and top_z(y) from top_z_along_y (both linear between their stations); the lip is the vertical band from rim_z to dome_base_z; the underside is offset 2.5 inward

bowl.rim_plan: canopy plan_half_width reduced by rim_inset at every station, between y 438 and 972
bowl.sides: rise from the flat refractor base (400 x 164, corner radius 55) outward to the rim in the section's curve at every y; the rim has a 6 x 6 bead
bowl.refractor: fine prismatic grooves on the base's underside, 2 mm pitch across the lantern (x)
bowl.loft: ring(z): the closed outline whose half width at y is hw(y, z) = bw(y) + (rw(y) - bw(y)) x s(z), for y from y_rear(z) to 1410 - y_rear(z); bw(y) is base_plan_half_width (0 outside y 505 to 905), rw(y) is the canopy's plan half width minus rim_inset, s(z) = (section_at_centre half width at z - 82) / (142 - 82), y_rear(z) is read off long_section_rear_curve_yz at z (its front end is its mirror about the lantern's centre y 705, that is 1410 - y): at z 4800 the ring is the flat base (y 505 to 905), at z 4925 it is the rim (y 438 to 972)
